name: ocs_by_date_source
sql: select split_part(match_key,'|',1) d, source, book, count(distinct match_key) fixtures, count(distinct match_key) filter (where is_selected) selected from odds_card_state where split_part(match_key,'|',1) between '2026-09-14' and '2026-09-27' group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3

name: oddspapi_fixtures_by_day_cat
sql: select coalesce(true_start,scheduled_start)::date d, category_name, count(*) n from oddspapi_fixtures where coalesce(true_start,scheduled_start) >= now() - interval '14 days' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: oddspapi_summary_by_day_cat
sql: select s.start_ts::date d, f.category_name, count(distinct s.fixture_id) fixtures, count(*) filter (where s.close_reliable) reliable_rows, count(*) rows_, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by s.close_lag_minutes) med_close_lag_min, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from (s.start_ts - s.first_tick_ts))/3600) med_open_lead_h from oddspapi_line_summary s left join oddspapi_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where s.market ilike '%winner%' and s.start_ts >= now() - interval '21 days' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: oddspapi_summary_markets
sql: select market, count(*) from oddspapi_line_summary group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 12

name: bet365_mw_ticks_by_day
sql: select loaded_at::date d, count(distinct card_key) cards, count(*) ticks from bet365_mw_ticks group by 1 order by 1 desc limit 10

name: postmatch_dispatch_log
sql: select * from postmatch_dispatch_log order by 1 desc limit 5

name: postmatch_alert_log
sql: select * from postmatch_alert_log order by 1 desc limit 5

name: postmatch_net_status
sql: select r.status_code, count(*) n, max(r.created) last from net._http_response r where r.id in (select (to_jsonb(l)->>'request_id')::bigint from postmatch_dispatch_log l) group by 1

name: kibl_leagues
sql: select f.league_id, count(*) fixtures, min(f.name) sample_name, min(f.scheduled_start) mn, max(f.scheduled_start) mx from kibl_fixtures f where f.scheduled_start >= now() - interval '7 days' group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 20

name: kibl_cover_7d
sql: with o as (select fixture_id, league_id, side_id from kibl_line_observations where observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days' and market_type_id = 1 and segment_id = 1 and betting_type_id = 1 and price_decimal >= 1.01 group by 1,2,3) select league_id, count(distinct fixture_id) fixtures_any, count(distinct fixture_id) filter (where fixture_id in (select fixture_id from o o2 group by 1 having count(distinct side_id) >= 2)) both_sides from o group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 20

name: kibl_open_lead_7d
sql: with x as (select f.league_id, f.fixture_id, min(o.inserted_on) first_ins, f.scheduled_start from kibl_line_observations o join kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where o.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days' and o.market_type_id=1 and o.segment_id=1 and o.betting_type_id=1 and o.price_decimal >= 1.01 group by 1,2,4) select league_id, count(*) n, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from scheduled_start-first_ins)/3600) med_lead_h, percentile_cont(0.1) within group (order by extract(epoch from scheduled_start-first_ins)/3600) p10_lead_h from x group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 10

name: ocs_close_lag_kibl_vs_oddspapi
sql: select source, book, ts_kind, count(*) filter (where close_price is not null) closes, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from start_ts-close_ts)/60) filter (where close_price is not null and start_ts is not null) med_close_lag_min, count(*) filter (where close_price is not null and start_ts is not null and start_ts - close_ts <= interval '60 minutes') within60, count(*) filter (where start_ts is null) no_start, count(*) rows_ from odds_card_state where split_part(match_key,'|',1) >= '2026-09-10' group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3

name: ocs_start_sources
sql: select source, start_ts_source, count(*) from odds_card_state where split_part(match_key,'|',1) >= '2026-09-10' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: rec_so_far
sql: select t.book, coalesce(e.tier,'(other)') tier, count(distinct t.event_id) events, count(*) ticks, min(t.seen_at) first, max(t.seen_at) last from ten287_rec.ticks t left join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: rec_requests
sql: select kind, status_code, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where note like 'lost%') lost from ten287_rec.requests group by 1,2 order by 1,2
